title: turath-catalog editors
description: One row per person, or body (a research centre, a committee), named as editor or contributor of an edition.

person_id.description: Stable id: `p_` + first 10 hex digits of sha1 of the folded name.

name_ar.description: The fullest form of the name found.

name_variants_ar.description: Shorter forms merged into this person, `;`-separated.

n_editions.description: Number of editions the person contributed to.
